name: Dranik Hollows: North
summary: A frigid cavern ridge where Muramite overwatch forces monitor Dragorn resistance movements.
description: Hollows North is a cold, jagged ridge of caverns carved upward toward Dranik’s Scar. The stone is brittle and frost‑scarred from Discord energy leaking through thin fissures. Muramite overwatch squads use elevated ledges to monitor resistance activity, while Dragorn rebels traverse narrow ridges to avoid detection. Discord frost pockets create sudden temperature drops and arcane instability. The terrain is steep, hazardous, and strategically vital for both sides.
